watchdog_ngos_searched: Democracy for the Arab World Now (DAWN)
adversarial_framing_check_finding: Lead Regional story (Aramco Q2 earnings amid the US-Iran war / Strait of Hormuz closure) names Saudi Arabia in a geopolitical/security context, so the check was applicable and was run. Checked Middle East Eye, The New Arab and Al Jazeera coverage of the same event: none framed Saudi Arabia as aggressor/oppressor; all frame Iran as the disruptor and Saudi as beneficiary/victim of the disruption. No adversarial-framing item resulted.
negative_hits_note: One genuine in-window reputational item: The Guardian (2026-08-04), 'Elon Musk's X latest to block Saudi dissident accounts inside kingdom' (human rights / digital repression; ALQST quoted). The Aramco/Iran-war cluster (Middle East Eye, CNN) is macro/oil coverage that frames Iran as aggressor, not adversarial to Saudi Arabia, and is not counted as a negative-on-Saudi hit. No standalone in-window statement from any of the nine watchdog NGOs.
